title: Bonk!
intro.text: Bonk each other off the islands! Damage doesn't kill – but the higher your percentage, the further you fly. Land in the abyss and you lose a life. 3 lives per round.
intro.controls: Phone: joystick to move · A = weapon · B = dodge roll · {alt}
intro.points: Knockout +100 · Round win +300 · 2nd +150 · 3rd +75 · Last round counts double · A power-up after every round, a shop every 4 rounds
weapon.title: Choose your weapon!
scores.title: Scores
final.title: Final scores
wd.hammer: Hold to charge, one hit decides. Special: ground stomp.
wd.schleuder: Hold = rapid fire from afar. Special: charged shot.
pick.startText: Everyone picks a power-up for their weapon on their phone.
pick.title: Pick a power-up
shop.title: Shop
shop.tv: Everyone spends their money on power-ups.
pud.brocken: You fly 15% less far but move 5% slower.
pud.feuerfest: Fire deals half damage and pushes half as hard.
pud.dornen: Whoever hits you in melee takes 5% themselves.
pud.siegeshunger: Every knockout heals 20% of your damage.
pud.flipper: Anyone you hit bounces off walls even harder.
pud.stampferplus: Stomp: 20% bigger and recharges much faster.
pud.erdbeben: Fully charged hits also send a shockwave all around.
pud.wirbelsturm: Charged hits strike everyone around you.
pud.abpraller: Pellets bounce off walls and pillars once.
pud.streuschuss: Every shot is 3 pellets in a fan.
pud.riesenkugel: Every 5th pellet is huge and knocks far.
pud.durchschlag: Pellets fly 50% further and through opponents.
wd.haken: Throw the hook: opponents get pulled to you, at walls you pull yourself over. Special: push hook.
wd.bomben: Throw bombs that explode after a moment – careful, they hit you too. Special: remote detonator.
wd.schwert: Fast 3-hit combo, the third hit knocks far. Hold the shield to block hits from the front.
wd.bumerang: Hits on the way out and on the way back. Special: recall instantly.
pud.doppelhaken: Hook is ready again much sooner.
pud.schleuderzug: Pulled opponents fly with much more momentum – even past you.
pud.haftbombe: Bombs stick to whoever they hit in flight.
pud.kettenreaktion: An explosion sets off nearby bombs instantly.
pud.dickerschild: Shield covers more and you move faster while blocking.
pud.konter: Block at the last moment and the attacker gets knocked away.
pud.klingenwelle: The third hit sends a wave forward.
pud.rueckholsog: On the way back the boomerang pulls hit players to you.
pud.spezial: New button: your hits charge a bar. When it's full, unleash your weapon's big attack.
shop.weaponText: Gets its own button, you keep the roll.
shop.weaponShield: You get the shield on its own button.
